meta.title: Projects
meta.description: Adds a Projects board to the left sidebar: one goal per project, project instructions, a shared memory and a task board. The coordinator splits the goal into tasks with the projects_* tools and dispatches them to parallel worker subagents, which run in the project workspace and report back for review. Data stays on this machine under $DSH_HOME/projects; workers run in-process and stop when the plugin is disabled.
